Current 700px dark/light frames show the incoming slot cue before pickup, outgoing tagged sheep 01 at 20/20, a truly empty selected region for 0.104 playback seconds, tagged sheep 07 at 0/20, and the same tag appearing only at its remote field drop.

proposals.change_target: fast turnover identity and pixel-pasture panel continuity
proposals.cause: Text-led outgoing/incoming cards demanded reading during a roughly 0.62-second exchange and duplicated information already present in roster number, fullness, field actor, and UFO motion.
proposals.candidate_change: Keep the pinned Galmuri7 Korean panel and restrained pasture perimeter, remove all replacement text cards, assign each roster identity one deterministic 3x3 ranch tag shared by its field actor, selected portrait, and roster slot, cue the next slot 0.54 source seconds before pickup, and leave the selected region empty for 0.08 source seconds between the outgoing and incoming identities.
proposals.discovery_evidence: Fresh current-source 700px dark/light frames show roster 07 visibly pre-cued while sheep 01 remains full, no fallback sheep in the 0.104-playback-second blank interval, sheep 07 appearing empty before the carrier reaches its remote drop, and the matching tag remaining on the dropped field actor. proposals.reproduction: Run npm run visual:fixture and npm run check, render forced dark/light representative and 10/62 variants at 700px, inspect cue/pickup/blank/incoming/drop/terminal frames, and rerun 30fps/120fps post-reveal actor continuity before independent promotion.
proposals.primary_metric: At 700px, the next sheep is legible before pickup, the outgoing and incoming identities are separated by one empty beat, and the same unique tag is preserved across field, portrait, and roster with zero text-card or clipping regressions.
proposals.prediction: A persistent ranch mark plus a pre-cued roster relay will communicate a different sheep faster and with less panel clutter than simultaneous replacement labels.
proposals.falsification_condition: Reject if any identity uses mismatched tags across field, selected, or roster; fewer than 300 sampled tags are unique; the next cue starts late; any sheep fills the blank handoff; a replacement text card remains; dense cells clip; an incoming actor slides from a stale coordinate; runtime exceeds 50 seconds; frozen-baseline size is exceeded; or npm run check fails.
proposals.regression_check: npm run check plus a fresh independent visual Gate over dark/light, reduced motion, 10/28/62 panels, adjacent turnover frames, terminal state, and 30fps/120fps incoming-actor continuity.
proposals.transfer_check: Not applicable; the ranch tag is a project-specific identity device for this animated SVG.
